strings.permissionPrompt: Claude wants to run {tool}. {description}. {preview}. Say yes or no.
strings.deviceCheckFailing: The audio device check keeps failing.
strings.audiodevMissing: A helper that npm run build makes is missing. Run npm run build in the voice channel folder, then type start voice.
strings.languageInstruction: The user speaks English. Reply in English.
strings.refusedDevice: Voice is off. The microphone is {input} and the output is {output}, and {which} is not on the allowed list. Fix the audio devices, then say start voice or type it.
strings.noDeviceConfigured: Voice is off because no microphone is on the allowed list yet. Run npm run setup in the voice channel folder, then type start voice.
strings.anotherSession: Voice is off because another voice session on this Mac is already listening. Stop that session, then say start voice or type it.
strings.hearRejectedDevice: The hear command will not record from {input}. Pick another microphone, then say start voice or type it.
strings.switchingModel: Switching to {model}. The conversation restarts in a moment.
strings.unknownModel: I do not know a model called {model}. Say opus, sonnet, haiku, or fable.
strings.confirmModel: Switch to {model}? The whole conversation is re-read on the new model, which uses tokens. Say yes or no.
strings.askEffort: Which effort for {model}? Say low, medium, high, or max.
strings.launchCue: Press Enter to start the session.
strings.launchCueSwitch: The model switch is waiting. Press Enter to continue.
